scope: New cfo_estimator_link: common reset, 500 MHz to nominal 150 MHz CDC, one-frame credit, atomic error packet, result backpressure and recovery

findings.title: Completion was counted before a real output handshake
findings.original_risk: Post-NBA-only monitoring and pre-handshake completion counts could miss valid withdrawal or payload change when ready is asserted, including an unretired final result.
fix_evidence: TB lines 60-65 check held result before NBA and record H only on m_valid && m_ready; inactive and duplicate retirements are rejected.
TB lines 131-134 drive ready on a slow-clock falling edge, observe the next rising-edge retirement, require output_fires == 1 on the next falling edge, and only then count completed/errors.
Verifier lines 40-55 require F/E terminal state before H; H marks the run ended, rejecting duplicate or later rows.
Verifier lines 64-65 require all 40 runs ended, exactly 22 F, 10 E, 8 D and 32 H; every normal/error run therefore needs one retirement.

checks: 171-bit FIFO packing and unpacking agree, including locked frame/generation and error status.
The fast side closes on the accepted terminal/error packet and reopens after the synchronized result-retirement toggle.
Link-error abort clears both backend paths; the error result remains pending until handshake. No second abort result is generated by the frozen cores.

Local XPM 2021.1 reset state machine keeps writer reset-busy through cross-domain reset handshakes; done_seen tracks the synchronized toggle while busy. No stale-toggle reopening was identified in the reviewed configuration.
The result sidecar saturation sum has sufficient width for 74 x 65535 and is stable while the single outstanding result is stalled.
LINK010 explicitly selects cfo_phase74_core_v2 and cfo_fft74_quality_v2; their frozen parser fixes preserve the reviewed core semantics.
rtl_assessment.backend_error_policy: Confirmed with root: link-detected metadata/index/count/upstream/S38_MIN errors return credit after their terminal result handshakes. Internal backend errors intentionally fail-stop, withhold credit and require common reset/abort; this is not automatic-recovery coverage.

tb_verifier_assessment.trace_terminal_order: F or E -> exactly one H -> ended; D ends a discard run without H
tb_verifier_assessment.timing_reason: Ready is driven on the slow falling edge. The TB samples the real handshake on the rising edge before DUT NBA updates, and finish_run checks output_fires on the following falling edge. Registered read-audit checks remain after the 10 ps NBA-settling delay.

boundaries: This is static review, not native compilation, simulation or a numeric PASS.
No physical CDC qualification, synthesis, implementation timing, sustained throughput or board qualification is implied.
The original full waveform front end, complete T11/T12/T13 chain and whole-task PASS are outside this review.
Internal backend fault injection and fail-stop recovery were not executed.
The current TB slow half-period is 3.333 ns at 1 ps precision, i.e. nominal 150 MHz; no exact-frequency qualification is asserted.
Source hashes identify the reviewed bytes. Subsequent edits require review of the changed scope.
